name: Delete a priority intelligence requirement
description: Delete a priority intelligence requirement Soft-deletes a PIR. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/{priority_id}

name: Delete an account interest for PIR Option 2
description: Delete an account interest for PIR Option 2 Deletes a structured account interest so later Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations no longer include it. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/{interest_id}

name: Get PIR constants (methods, dimensions, and TLP values)
description: Get PIR constants (methods, dimensions, and TLP values) Requirements is the existing free-form PIR method. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/constants
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/constants
Requirements is the existing free-form PIR method. Interests is the experimental structured-interest method, evaluated independently from requirements.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get a priority intelligence requirement by ID
description: Get a priority intelligence requirement by ID Returns a single free-form Priority Intelligence Requirement for the authenticated account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/{priority_id}

name: Get a persisted account-interest backtest
description: Get a persisted account-interest backtest Returns a previously completed account-interest backtest by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/backtests/{backtest_id}

name: Get a persisted account-interest evaluation
description: Get a persisted account-interest evaluation Returns a previously completed live account-interest evaluation by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/evaluations/{evaluation_id}

name: List account interests for PIR Option 2
description: List account interests for PIR Option 2 Lists structured account interests for Priority Intelligence Option 2. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests
Lists structured account interests for Priority Intelligence Option 2. Filter by enabled state and paginate results.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); enabled (query)

name: List priority intelligence requirements for an account
description: List priority intelligence requirements for an account Lists free-form Priority Intelligence Requirements for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence
Lists free-form Priority Intelligence Requirements for the account. Results are scoped to the authenticated account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query)

name: Update an account interest for PIR Option 2
description: Update an account interest for PIR Option 2 Updates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/{interest_id}
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/{interest_id}
Updates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. Changing the value re-resolves the interest against the current catalog.
Required: account_id (path); interest_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Create a priority intelligence requirement
description: Create a priority intelligence requirement Creates a new PIR for the account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence
Creates a new PIR for the account. Subject to the account's annual PIR quota from the cfone.priority_intelligence_requirement_limit entitlement.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Backtest account-interest change detection
description: Backtest account-interest change detection Uses bounded full-span top-N candidates and daily event-date buckets. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/backtests
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/backtests
Uses bounded full-span top-N candidates and daily event-date buckets. Results are conservative rather than an exact historical replay.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Create an account interest for PIR Option 2
description: Create an account interest for PIR Option 2 Creates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests
Creates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. Interests are evaluated independently from free-form PIR requirements.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Evaluate recent event-dated changes for account interests
description: Evaluate recent event-dated changes for account interests Compares the trailing event-date window with the preceding window. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/evaluations
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/interests/evaluations
Compares the trailing event-date window with the preceding window. Results are precision-gated to enabled account interests. Late ingestion can cause an older event to appear in a later evaluation, so results describe changes in event-dated intelligence rather than exact adversary-activity timing.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Get PIR quota for an account
description: Get PIR quota for an account Returns the account's annual PIR quota including total allowed, remaining, and anniversary dates. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/quota
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/quota
Returns the account's annual PIR quota including total allowed, remaining, and anniversary dates.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update a priority intelligence requirement
description: Update a priority intelligence requirement Updates a free-form Priority Intelligence Requirement for the authenticated account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/{priority_id}
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/priority-intelligence/{priority_id}
Updates a free-form Priority Intelligence Requirement for the authenticated account.
Required: account_id (path); priority_id (path)
Optional: body (body)
